title: The Agent SDK
hook_text: Cursor just released an Agent SDK
script:
Cursor just released an Agent SDK for building custom AI agents.
This SDK lets you craft agents that live inside your code editor.
You define custom instructions that guide how your agent behaves and responds.
Developers use these agents to automate specific workflows within their own projects.
The SDK is available now for all users on the Cursor platform.
It marks a move toward more personalized AI tools for software engineering.
Would you let an AI agent manage your production environment?
